batting.name: KD Karthik
batting.dismissal: c KV Sharma b I Sharma

batting.name: RG Sharma
batting.dismissal: c I Sharma b A Mishra

batting.name: PA Reddy
batting.dismissal: c DR Smith b MG Johnson

batting.name: GH Vihari
batting.dismissal: c AT Rayudu b DS Kulkarni

balls.text: and the third four of the over, it was very full and slightly wide, probably made more so by the moving Pollard, driven through the wide long-off fielder for a four! Steyn dives to the left and makes a valiant attempt but misses
full-toss and smacked hard, bit straight to the fielder at long-off for a single, well fielded by Steyn

what a shot! there was no deep fielder on the off side and the batsman was looking to go across the off side and hit it over the leg-side, the ball was wide outside the off and he slices it over the in-field!
finally a four! it was on a length and outside the off, he hits it inside out, through wide long-off for a four
he tries to walk away to the off side and scoop it over the fine-leg fielder but it's too quick and goes through to the keeper, between the batsman and the stumps
and another one that is so full that the batsman cannot get it away, only back down to the ground for a single
full-toss and that's been given a no-ball for being over the waistline, pulled away to the leg side for a single

whoa and he was looking to scoop it over fineleg, misses and it's hit his pads, Steyn appeals hard, then fields the ball and appeals again! The umpire has already said no, probably because it's hitting outside the off and Steyn has his hands on his mouth in surprise!
this is good bowling from Steyn, very full, very straight and very fast, no chance for the batsmen to get it anywhere but straight and for a single
another one that's so full that it's very difficult to get him away, can only tap it to the leg side and away they go for a single
was moving around in his crease and tucks it away to the leg side for a single
and another one! well bowled yorker that almost takes his shin off, got some bat on it and goes straight to square-leg for a quickly taken single
fast, in-dipping yorker, taps it away to the leg side for a single
and another well-bowled yorker which Pollard tries to smash over some place, does not get any bat on it
goes down the track and pushes it to the off side for a single
he was trying the yorker there and gets it very full, hits the inside edge of the bat and hits the pads, there was some in-swinging reverse as well
fuller on the off stump and he drives it to extra-cover for a single
slower ball and picked well by the batsman, pulled it away over the mid-wicket for a four, well played that
very full and with a round-arm action, he did not have room to free his arms and drills it hard into the ground for a single over the bowler
tries to go over the top but does not get it off the middle of the bat, bit of the bottom and it flies off to the wide long-off region for a couple
and he pauses in his action before delivering that, bit of an Ashwin there, defended it to the off side
goes inside out and is easily able to play it through the covers for a couple of runs, well bowled and equally well played
fuller and quicker, not too much of an arm movement from the batsman and it goes on the bounce to the long-on
and again! this was the leggie and he was looking to play it over the off but the turn defeats him
and he tries to go over the top, beats him off the wrong 'un and does not connect, was looking to go over the in-field, misses
fullish from Steyn and driven well to mid-off, but straight and quickly to him and cannot take a single
fuller from the bowler and pushed down to long-on for a single, another delivery bowled at 147.4 km/hr
and a quick bouncer from Steyn, 146.3 km/hr and he was looking to almost evade it, gets some bat on it in the attempt to fend it away, goes through to the third-man area
and this time he compensates by getting it very close to his pads, is only able to tap it away to mid-wicket
short, wide and cracks it through the backward point area for a four, there was some width there and he takes full advantage of that one
fullish from him, and did I spot a bit of deviation back into the batsman, pushed to the covers
fuller, slower and he had to suddenly wait for it before pushing it into the covers for a single
walks down the pitch and tries thwack it away, can get it away to the mid-wicket region for a single
another one that's dug shorter but outside the off stump, wants to pull it away, the ball fails to arrive as quickly as he would have liked and it rolls over to the leg side
short of length and pulled away to the leg side, does not come on to the bat and gets him only a single

slightly outside the off stump and he's able to open the face of the bat and guide it through the backward point region for a couple of runs, Mishra does a good job in the field, which is not what Ishant did when he dropped one off Mishra
shorter in length and it's pushed to the off side
and a very good ball to end the over, yorker length and he need to get his bat down in a hurry to dig it out, goes through to the keeper
very wide outside the off and to add to that woe, Sanga misses it too, a couple of extras added to the score
outside the off stump and enough width to free his arms, tries to cut it away, but straight to the fielder
another one that's on the length and its pushed back to the bowler
short of length from the bowler, he stands up tall and pushes it down to long-on for a single
on the middle stump, not allowing him room to free his arms and taking pace off it too, pushes it to mid-wicket
on his pads and easily tucked away to the leg side for a single
shorter in length, or probably made it shorter by playing off the back foot, punched to the long-on fielder for a single

and another one! Mishra takes another, his second and 90th in IPL, he was looking to sweep it, was too full to sweep and the umpire reckons it's hit the pads in front of the stumps! Replays show it has come off the glove on to the pads!
smashed away, slog swept to the deep mid-wicket region for a four! there was a fielder there and beats him easily!
a slightly poor delivery to follow it up, down the leg side and he's able to tuck it away to the leg side for a single
an appeal for an lbw, that was a googly, beats the batsman and hits the pads, was probably, just probably going over!

and gone this time, Mishra's taken a wicket and Ishant's taken a catch! it was floated up by Mishra and he goes for a massive shot over the long-off fielder, does not time it too well, straight to the fielder!
almost a run-out, he was looking to tip and run, but slipped on his way back, luckily he was not too far down the pitch before he decided there was no run on that one!
shorter in length and cut it away to the deep point fielder for a single
shorter in length and punched down to long-on for a single
shimmy down the pitch from Rohit and drives it all the way on the ground to long-on for a single
fullish from the bowler and he was looking to drive it down, gets an outside edge through to the covers for a single
on the leg stump and pushed down to long-on for a single
stands up tall and punches it down the ground for a single to long-off
wants to drive it through the covers, does not get it off the middle, through to the covers
defended back to the bowler this time
bit of a leading edge and it runs down to long-off for a single
dropped! what a sitter tipped over the long-off fence by Ishant! he was very inside the fence and had to move back, got the hand on it, misjudged and tips it over
shorter in length and pushes it down the ground for a single
taps it through the covers for another single to get Rohit across
tries to go over the top, does not hit the middle of the bat and it falls short of the deep mid-wicket fielder
quicker but still there's spin, he's quickly on to the back foot and defended back to the bowler
fuller and driven to long-on for a single, he's getting some turn here for sure
outside edge to one that turns away from the bat, hits the keeper's pads on it's way through to short third-man
very full from Karan and Rohit is able to easily drill it away through the extra-cover region for a couple of runs
not as full this time and it's driven down to long-off for a single
fuller and defends on the front foot, pushes it to the covers and they are away for a quick single
turn from Mishra and defended off the back foot to the off side
on the off and turning away from the bat, he turns it towards the long-on against the spin, could have taken a leading edge there, misfielded by Mishra
quicker on the pads, flicked away to the leg side for a single
slower, flighted up and defended back to the bowler
slow turn away from the batsman and easily cut away to the deep fielder for a single
finally hits it off the middle, finally hits it hard and finally it goes to the fence! was on a good length and Smith times it over the bowler for a four
up to the bat, and driven down to long-off for a single
fuller from the bowler this time, driven well but again to one of the in-field players on the off side
pushed to the off side, to the short cover region, straight to the fielder
fuller on the off stump and not too much turn on that one, driven through the covers for a single
outside edge through to the third-man for a single, the only run that over
outside the off stump and Smith has done something he would have probably not done often in this format, shouldered arms in the seventh over of the game
this one  he gets it slightly further up to the bat, he pushes it to mid-off but without too much power on that shot
and another one defended back to the bowler, it was on a length and he was looking to play forward, done well to play it with a straight bat
and this time he comes closer to the middle stump, it's defended off the back foot to the leg side
almost another! he gets one to nip slightly away from the batsman, who was looking to defend it off the front foot, beats the outside edge through to the keeper

another four, well-timed and beats the mid-on fielder! it was fullish from the bowler but did not come on too well, Rohit was looking to drive it straight, was in the air but eludes the mid-on fielder
driven on the up and superbly driven through the point region, there was some width there and easily played away, a graceful stroke too
and another straight-batted defensive stroke, played to the off side
slower from the bowler, or it came on slower off the track, Rohit defends it to the off side
on his pads and it's tucked away to the leg side, they are through for a single
begins with one that's short of length and defended back to the bowler
ooh, almost an edge, misses the outside half of the bat as the captain looks to play on the front foot, well bowled sir!
gone, loose shot, on the up and straight to the point fielder! it was on the off stump and short of length, tried to hit it on the up and it goes to point, simple catch, gone!
on his pads and Karthik was moving towards the off, gets hit on his pads and it rolls over to the leg side

bowled him! Tendulkar's got out to one that he believes has kept a tad low but I feel it's more to do with the face that there was a gap between the bat and pad there that got exploited well by Ishant, short of length it was and sneaks through!
on his pads and he was falling over to the off stump, gets hit on his pads, rolls over to the leg side for a single
middle stump line and the batsman is able to tuck it away, again signs that the ball did not come on to the bat, pushed to short mid-wicket
finally ends the over, on the off stump, short of length, pushed to the mid-off fielder
another wide now, it's on the off side now! bouncer, outside the off and it looks to be inside the line, given wide though
fuller on the off stump and he leans into the drive, off the middle of the bat and to the mid-off fielder.
tucked it to the leg side for a couple now, this is to the left of the deep fielder there, and he is able to come back for two
and now down the leg-side for a wide, he was attempting a quicker one here but loses his line
aah, class! it was fuller on the leg-stump and the batsman goes through with a straight bat, smashes it over the bowler for a four!

hit it away and for a four! what a shot! it was almost flicked away but with an intention of lofting it over the in-field, there was a fielder at deep square-leg and it was quite close to him, on his right, he misread it I think
hit on the up, fluently hit to the cover region but is unable to pierce the gap, well played but not for runs
does not bounce too much, it's on a good length yet again and on the off stump, defended into the covers
quicker this time and on a good length, pushes it to the off side but to the fielder
yep, that's how you unwind, he muscle it over the bowler's head and you hit it for a six! it was a length ball and he gives it his all, smacked it away!
oh no, a no-ball, which is defended away to the off side
on the up this time, again the slowness of the ball did not help the batsman, hit uppishly but in the gap, a dive to his left restricts him to one
comes down the track this time, attempts to disrupt his length but Ishant's done well to get it on the right channel and he can only tap it away to the off side
shorter on length, 133.5 km/hr, but it came slowly on to the bat, he's able to work it away to the leg side for a single
through the covers this time, he adjusts to the slow nature of the delivery, opens the face of the bat but vitally finds the gap for a couple of runs
on the middle stump line this time but full enough for Smith to flick it away to the deep square-leg region, the fielders in that position and they get only a single
on a length again and he was looking to play it on the front foot, again not too much pace on it and easily played to mid-on
on a good length and tapped to the off side, the ball did not come on to the bat I thought
bit of swing away from the bat and it gets an edge through to the third-man for a single
fuller, not very quick but on the money and defended on the front foot, back to the bowler
tries to tuck it away to the leg side, but isn't able to, hits his pads
left alone this, and it was a top=spinner, misses the off-stump by a bit, some bounce too
spins away from the batsman, some turn away, beats the batsman's outside edge
this time defended off the back foot, back to the bowler
on a good length, quicker, angled in and it's defended to the leg side, they are able to get back for a second
up and over for a four! what a start, fuller on the off stump and hit over the mid-off fielder for a fence-hitter!
fullish yet again and driven to mid-off, they are off for a quick single, to finish it off there, easily done in the end
outside the off stump, very wide outside in fact and he fails to get any bat on that, also called wide by the ump
fuller outside the off stump and driven through to short cover, again not for runs
fuller outside the off stump and he drives it straight to the point fielder, not for runs
short of length and pulled away to fine-leg for a single

and now he's gone! short of length and pulls it straight into the hands of short mid-wicket, gone, caught! not that it will make any different here but would have been good to see him through to the victory

dropped, Pollard's dropped it at point and it looks like he's done his finger! short ball from the bowler and he was looking to pull it, the ball lobs up to the point fielder, Pollard dives in front of him and floors it, he seems to have jammed his finger there and he's off the field
short of length and he wants to hook it away, goes on the bounce to Mitchell Johnson at fine-leg
bouncer that makes Vihari go down quickly, does it well too and lets it pass by
fuller and driven down the ground for a single, oh but wait, there's a misfield there by Chahal and they are able to come back for the second
hit over the covers for a four, even Vihari joins the act now after an innings of great patience and intelligence, slices it over the covers
yorker length and beats the outside edge of the bat, through to the keeper
slows it down considerably and easily pushes it through the covers for a single
cuts it through the covers for a single to Hyderabad closer to a very easy win
driven through to wide long-off for a couple of runs, bit of a misfield from Pollard and they come back for the second
what happened there, hits Karthik's gloves and pops up again and catches it, bit of an appeal but not-out given, he was looking to cut it, but was too close to it
on his pads, shorter in length, he paddles it hard, almost whacks it easily to the fence
round the stumps and tapped away to the leg side, not too much pace in the shot and they are able to come back for the second, well run that
full-toss and hit down the ground, over the bowler's head for a single
fuller and swept it away to fine-leg, well played and they are able to get back for the second, even worse, it's a no-ball from a spinner

and another one that's pulled away to the fence for a four, it was short of length and pulled away to backward square-leg to the fence, this is all over bar the shouting unless Malinga can get in those yorkers out
fuller in length and tapped back into the pitch, back to the bowler, fielded well
and as if to show he can hit them off his pads too, gets it on the leg side and flicked away to deep mid-wicket for a couple
on his pads and easily tucked away through the mid-wicket region, single for the batsman who wanted to come back for the second, Dhawan stops him
and another one that's cut away, almost lazily, through to third-man, single to Dhawan
sort of length delivery from MJ and easily cracked over the point region for a four, short and wide and easily done!
goes down the track and time time he's drilled it down to long-off for a single
the guy's in cracking form and he shows how, he goes down the track and smashes it over the extra-cover region for a four, gets to his 50 off only 40 balls on a difficult pitch, well played!
pushed it to the off side, to Pollard yet again, not for runs

slower bouncer from the bowler and Dhawan reads it very well, waits on it and pulls it away, in fact rolls his wrists over that one, fielded well by Johnson at deep square-leg running from fine-leg and restricts it to 2
and he's drilled it through the point region for a couple of runs, it was fuller and he comes down the track and cuts it away through the off side
yorker first up but not at full pace, pushed down the ground for a single
gets some room outside the room and easily cracks it away through the covers for a couple of runs, well run there and Dhawan's able to get back before the stumps are destroyed by Karthik
flicked away to the leg side for a single
this time he's played it away well to the off side, defended and off for a run
slightly shorter and it's defended on to the off side, quick fielding effort prevents a single
goes down the track again and for the third time he's not been able to play that delivery on the middle stump away, hits his pads
slows it down, on the pads and tapped away to the leg side for a single
on his pads and flicked away through fine-leg for a four, good shot that and brings up 15 from the over to bring Hyderabad right back into the game
flicked away to fine-leg for a single this time, 11 already off it
poor delivery, long hop, on a slow pitch it sits up to be hit and Vijari does not even rock back, just pulls it away over mid-wicket for a single
and now cuts it through the squarer region on the off side for a single
superbly cut away to the fence, it was a short of length and cuts away through back point for a four
fuller from Smith and on the middle stump, it's driven down the ground for a single
paddles it around the corner to fine-leg for a single, Malinga rushes across and tries to field it, doesn't quite get it cleanly but the batsman get only a single
tucked it away to deep square-leg for a single
goes down the track and he shortens the length, tucks it to short fine-leg, wants a run but is sent back, misfielded by Harbhajan but still no run
defended to the leg side and to the close-in fielder
slog sweep attempted and missed! the ball also misses the stumps and the keeper's gloves, could have been a stumping chance too, the batsman was slightly out of his crease
shorter from Ojha and easily tapped down the ground for a single
outside the off stump, does not turn back into the batsman who opens the face of the bat and plays it to short third-man for a single
swept away by Dhawan, gets it to the 45 fielder at fine-leg for a single
defended off the back foot to the short cover fielder, he wants a single but is sent back
slows it down and he's quickly out again and pushes it to short cover fielder
shorter in length and punched down the ground for a single
quickly on to the back foot and defended to the off side, a quick shout of yes and away they go
down the leg side and he wants to paddle sweep it, misses and it's a wide called
very short from the bowler and easily pulled away to the deep square-leg region for a single
slows it down well and easily tucked away to the leg side for a single
and now some turn and bounce, taps it to the off side
fuller on the middle stump and he gets his bat and pad out and defends
tucked away to short fine-leg for a single where sub fielder Chahal comes in quickly to field it
from round the stumps, on the middle stump and a hint of turn back, defended back

gone, caught and bowled, soft dismissal! it was an ordinary ball, on the middle stump, Sanga was trying half-defend, half push and he ends up spooning it back to the bowler who has to go low down and takes the catch
again down the track but no room this time, tapped away to the leg side for a single
what a shot, what timing from Dhawan! he was going down the track and not looking to hit hard at all, just times it with a short-arm punch and it goes over long-off for a six!
fuller and he's just pushed it through the in-field for a single to deep covers
slightly shorter from Harbhajan now and he's easily able to rock back and cut it away to deep point for a single
on the middle and angling down from round the stumps, nurdled away to the leg side for a single
wants to come down and smack it over the leg side, but Ojha fires it quicker and flatter on his pads, does get the bat
tries to cut it from very close to the stumps, it was turning back into the batsman and plays it well through to point for a single
a classy looking cut, that goes to the deep point fielder for a single
and he's now back to going down the pitch and defends it this time
cut away and to the fence! this was a tad shorter from Ojha, who probably thought he would come down the track, instead he goes back and plays it very late, easily beats the fielder
short and pulled away, will be disappointed to get only one off it, straight to mid-wicket
and now he defends it back to the bowler to end the Powerplay overs.
inside out and he's almost caught! he was looking to smack it away but gets it over the head of Smith at short cover, think it hit his finger-tips, couple to long-off
shorter in length from the spinner, he wants to cut it but the ball does not quite find the gap
fuller this time, Sanga expected that and he only pushes it back down the ground for a single
and another one, very short, very wide and that's easy pickings, drilled through the covers for another four, two in two for the Sunrisers!
very short, a tad wide after the ball turns away and easily cut away through the covers for a four, poor delivery from Harbhajan

another excellent effort from Pollard at a point position very close to the bat, he was looking to cut it away and he dives it to his right, fields and throws it back to the stumps, misses yet again but full marks for the fielding
shorter in length and taps it into the covers for a quickly taken single
slammed to the covers and what an effort from Rayadu, this was sizzling through to the fence but Rayadu dives to his right and does well to field
ooh, and beaten this time! it was outside the off, quicker, on a length and he wanted to drive, not full enough to drive and gets no bat on it
pulls his length back a tad and Sanga tries to cut it through the covers, but the lack of pace does not allow him to get it away
fuller, not really yorker length, was swinging back into the batsman and he has gently flicked it away to the mid-wicket region for a four
and he now goes down the track and drives it down to mid-on for a single
pushes into the covers, five dot balls here
and that's beaten him again, again it's kept a tad low, not too much turn and beats the batsman
quicker from round the stumps and angling into the batsman, wanted to cut it but straight to the fielder
slower this time and defended off the front foot, back to the bowler
whoa, turn for Harbhajan, when did that happen last, it was turning and bouncing and beats the outside edge of the bat
and again, straight to Pollard, short of length, tries to skim it through the covers, straight to the point fielder, not for a run
slower from Johnson and he is looking to defend it, pushes it into the covers and off they go for a single to Pollard again, trying too many singles to one of the better fielders in the side
shorter in length from MJ and he pulls it away to fine-leg for a single
not the best of deliveries, on his pads and he is easily able to tuck it to fine-leg for a single to get off the mark

slower one and he's gone this time! it was fuller for a change after all those early ones that were short of length, Reddy was looking to slice it over the covers but does not get too much bat and it lobs up easily for Smith at covers, first blood to Mumbai
cut away, short of length and well hit by Reddy but Pollard dives to his right and fields well, no run this time
and now its hammered through the point region! it was a length ball and he shimmies down and cracks it through that area, easily beats the in-fielder and the third-man for a four
and now he goes down the pitch and wants to crack it through the covers, slower one and pushed into the covers
almost a run-out, needed another direct hit there, fielded by Pollard from a cut by the batsman, they decided to go for a single and it's badly misjudged, needed a direct hit though

slower one from the bowler and he has pushed it to Pollard at point, the non-striker gets away running but Dhawan isn't sure, bit of misunderstanding there, and could have been out had he hit it direct at the non-striker's end
punched through the wide mid-off region for a four! it was on a length and he only pushed at it, easily done and gone to the boundary
on a length and a bit of nip away from the batsman, had his bat hung out, beats the outside edge and through to the keeper
flicked away to the leg side and they want to come back for the second, that's what they do, the throw comes in from Rayadu but not collected by the bowler and Dhawan's in

bouncer that flies away for a four! byes given, but that was rapid, 143.5 km/hr. he was looking to pull it away, missed by a distance, as did the keeper and it flies away, surprisingly the umpire gives it runs
he's refusing to pitch it very full and pushing the batsman on to his back foot, tapped away to the point region, again a dot
another shorter in length delivery, he's back and defending, not for runs again
full-toss outside the off stump, one that should have been drilled through the covers or straight down the ground, hits it straight to mid-off
short of length and he is immediately on to his back foot, defending it into the covers
